title.narrative: Supporting hydroelectric electricity generation increase in Vietnam

description.narrative: The project aims at 1) reinforcing energy security in South Vietnam to cope with the increase in daily power consumption; and 2) supporting the development of renewable, low-carbon energy, thus contributing to GHG emission reduction.Specific objectives of actions financed through EU funds: 1) Improving Health, Safety and Environment management systems on the hydropower extension construction sites handled by EVN and 2) Maximizing power generation from existing plants by optimizing O&M process

title.narrative: Ialy hydropower plant operation and maintenance (O&M) optimization process

description.narrative: The first phase will consists in the identification of potential improvement through visits of existing hydropower plants: this will allow to establish diagnosis of the maintenance procedures currently used by EVN. International standards and best practices will be presented to EVN teams, as well as the latest technological development regarding computerised maintenance management system. During this phase, a study tour may be organised to present the experience of a foreign utility.The second phase will consist in supporting EVN in elaborating a maintenance optimisation process. This process will be applied to Ialy existing hydropower plant as a pilot phase.

title.narrative: Devising and implementing a pilot HSE management system consistent with international standards for Ialy hydropower plant

description.narrative: The system developed for Ialy 2 shall consist of a combined HSE Management System addressing all health, safety and environmental aspects. It shall be consistent with Vietnamese Laws, ISO 140001 (Environmental Management Systems) addressing environmental aspects, and with OHSAS 18001/ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems) for health and safety aspects and shall apply a PlanDoCheckAct approach.
